name: Qube Browser 0.4.0 (v2)
notes:
Qube v2 is here. A brand-new engine, Apple Music built in, and more of the Arc you love than ever. This is the biggest Qube update yet.

A whole new engine:
* Qube now runs on Chromium's full browser, so sites work just like they do in Chrome
* Your sign-ins, site data and permissions move over by themselves
* Protected video and H.264, AAC and HEVC playback, so streaming just works
* Chrome's own right-click menu, with View Source and Inspect
* Starts faster, with no black window and no wait after an update

Your music, built in:
* Apple Music lives inside Qube: your library, search and playlists in the Library
* A player in the sidebar, next to everything else that plays
* Now Playing with lyrics in the side panel (Settings > Music to sign in)
* Music and the side panel come right back after a restart

Watch and listen:
* Picture in picture, by hand or the moment you leave a playing video
* Media tabs: Spotify, Netflix, Disney+, Prime Video, HBO Max, Videoland and NPO, each in a tab of its own, signed in
* Media players in the sidebar with Arc's volume slider, and titles that scroll when they don't fit
* Music notes dance over any tab that plays sound; click its icon to mute it

The Arc you missed:
* Profiles, as in Arc: each Space picks one, and Spaces can share it
* Create Spaces right in the sidebar, drag them into your own order
* Air Traffic Control: links from other apps land in the Space you choose
* Arc's app menu under the logo, Tab groups that save as folders, Reveal Tab in Sidebar
* Your own icon on tabs, Essentials, folders and Spaces: an icon, an emoji or a picture
* Fold your pinned tabs with one click on the Space's name
* Ctrl+S shows and hides the sidebar, just like Arc

Work the way you want:
* More than one window (Ctrl+N), and private windows (Ctrl+Shift+N)
* A side panel for extensions, DevTools, Apple Music, or any tab you open in it
* Drag and drop: drop files, text and links onto a page, or drag from a page into another app
* Search any site straight from the command bar: type its name and press Tab
* Import from Arc or Zen, alongside what you have or instead of it
* Qube Spark: hold Shift over a link for a preview, and let Tidy sort your tabs (with Claude Code)

Made to feel good:
* The first start after your PC boots, Qube unpacks itself from its own box
* The window fades in only once your page is ready
* Folders open and close with Zen's animation, rows and buttons fade as you point at them
* Space colours and sidebar text drawn exactly the way Zen draws them
* Sharp favicons, smoother resizing, and no more little stalls

And more:
* History as a page (Ctrl+H), archived tabs in the Library
* Downloads fly to the Library button, with Retry and Copy Link
* Save as PDF (Ctrl+Shift+S) and Print (Ctrl+P)
* Site notifications, email links, and devices (Bluetooth, USB, serial, HID) for sites that ask
* Settings redesigned as Windows 11 cards, with Chromium's own pages built in
* Busy background tabs rest in energy saver and unload when memory runs low
* A setup guide that gets you going on first start

Fixed:
* Links from other apps now reach a Qube that is already open
* Downloads from every Space show up, and never overwrite a file with the same name
* Clear Cookies clears the Space you are in
* Deleting a Space no longer signs you out, and a deleted profile's data is really gone
* Imports from Zen and Arc keep your Essentials and theme colours right
* Private Spaces leave no site icons behind

Good to know:
* Extensions don't move to the new engine on their own: Qube lists yours with a link to the Web Store, and their saved data comes back when you add them
* Qube isn't signed yet, so Windows' Smart App Control blocks it. Turn it off in Windows Security > App & browser control
* The update is about 420 MB, and Qube steps away for a minute or two while it installs
* A second window has no side panel yet, and fullscreen and automatic picture in picture work in the first window
* Touchpad swipe is still untested
summary: Qube v2 is here: a brand-new engine, Apple Music built in, and more of the Arc you love than ever.

mac.name: Qube for Mac 0.3.2
mac.notes:
Added:

* Create a Space in the sidebar: name, icon, profile and theme, before it is made
* Collapse your pinned tabs: click the Space's name
* Hold the mouse button on the Space buttons and sweep across them to go through your Spaces
* The Library has icons of its own that move when you choose a section, in your Space's colour
* The Library button is a toy box: point at it and its stars come up

Changed:

* The sidebar follows Zen's sizes, spacing, corners and colours, without glass on glass
* Switching Spaces slides the old one out as the new one comes in, over half a second
* Clear and Tidy stay under your pinned tabs instead of scrolling away
* The URL bar stays put when you switch Spaces
* A new Space's empty Essentials area is no taller than a row of Essentials

Fixed:

* Importing from Zen put every Essential in every Space
* Importing from Arc gave some Spaces the wrong colours
* The Library's section buttons stretched to the window's height
* On a click, the new Space showed over the old one for a moment before it slid in

Known:

* To fix an earlier import, import again and choose Replace
mac.summary: A sidebar that looks and moves more like Zen's, and a Library of Qube's own.
